objective_contribution: Compress evidence identity at the model boundary while retaining exact external provenance, testing whether ARE can improve terminal context selection with fewer model tokens.

question_and_hypotheses.question: Can request-local evidence handles preserve exact delivered-evidence selection while reducing GLM-5.3-flash terminal-review input by at least 128 tokens at 8K?

experiment_and_task_refs.unresolved: Handle implementation, exact-resolution proof, provider calibration, fresh selection, repositories, scorer, preflight, freeze, live run, score, and reviewed decision.

measurement_mapping.native: Quality uses the fixed eight-identity denominator after handles resolve to exact delivered read IDs.
measurement_mapping.retention: Treatment exposes at most three short handle/path/range records at the held terminal boundary.
measurement_mapping.integrity: Private mappings are receipt-bound; full IDs are absent from the prompt; unknown and duplicate handles fail closed with complete diagnostics.
measurement_mapping.tokens: Every model input and output token counts; exact provider calibration precedes freeze.
measurement_mapping.transfer: External identity compression applies to evidence-backed workflows beyond code, while this run remains GLM code-context evidence.

acceptance_and_scope.window_order: GLM small-window chapter before larger windows
acceptance_and_scope.stopping_rules: Stop immediately on mapping, non-disclosure, token, ancestry, or minimum-pair failure.

retained_counterevidence: Round 50 full-ID treatment input exceeded control by 28 tokens.
Round 50 treatment still recovered a valid three-file selection while control selected none.
Changing the terminal schema may introduce a compliance failure even when it saves tokens.
successor_rule: An H70 pass advances to independent confirmation; a valid failure selects H71, H62, H0, or a new observation-led hypothesis.

criterion_verdicts.enduring_objective: H70 reduces model-visible identity cost without discarding external evidence integrity.
criterion_verdicts.current_milestone: The experiment remains inside the fixed ContextBench loop.
criterion_verdicts.method_and_predecessor: Round 50 counterevidence selects H70 against H71, H62, and H0.
criterion_verdicts.counterevidence: Schema compliance and semantic loss remain explicit falsifiers.
criterion_verdicts.measurement_and_token_cost: Provider-token savings and all live input plus output tokens are measured.
criterion_verdicts.scope_and_acceptance: Fresh development canary only; no benchmark clearance claim.
criterion_verdicts.testability: Mapping, non-disclosure, diagnostics, resolution, and token savings are exact gates.
